name: PaddleOCR
description: Converts documents, receipts, and images into structured data with OCR, layout analysis, and table recognition, exposed to agents via a Python API, CLI, and MCP server.

skills.name: Text Recognition
skills.description: Extracts printed and handwritten text from images and scanned PDFs across more than 80 languages.

skills.name: Layout Analysis
skills.description: Detects document structure including headings, paragraphs, figures, and reading order before extraction.

skills.name: Table Recognition
skills.description: Parses tables from scans into structured HTML or Markdown while preserving row and column spans.

skills.name: Document Pipeline
skills.description: Runs end-to-end pipelines chaining detection, recognition, and structure parsing into JSON output.
